part3.why: Skipped on purpose: the till opens no selling surface, F&B included, until a station is taken (apps/pos/src/App.tsx: fleetAvailable && !station shows the StationPicker). Taking one is a write, so the till was not opened at all.

chineseTea.expected: 140 under Tea pot at both parks

demoItemsCentral.note: All 28 demo FB-/MR- codes are archived; the 5 AO- add-ons are the kept ones. Live rows that share a demo name are real menu lines (CF-42 Pad Thai, CF-58-4 Latte, AO-GRIPSOCKS Grip Socks) or the uncoded Ice Cream Cone below.

differences: Central has 5 further live rows with no code, outside the seed and outside the demo codes, so --retire-demo (which works by code) left them: Ice Cream Cone (menu, 60, in the demo-era category F&B), Bracelet Workshop (add-on, 150, Ticket add-ons, also offered on the booking site), Mystery box (merch, 0, Toys), Native payment free item 0d008153 (merch, 0, Apparel), ZZ TEST Stock 496 Mug (merch, 10, Apparel). Central live total is therefore 162 = 152 real + 5 AO- add-ons + 5 uncoded.
Chalong has 1 further live row with no code: ZZ TEST Spend Cup 1007 (menu, 40, Snacks). Chalong live total is 150 = 149 real + 1.

The 12 demo-era categories are still live operator-wide (F&B, Food, Mains, Light Bites, Drinks, Coffee, Bar, Snacks, Apparel, Accessories, Toys, Ticket add-ons), so the Console lists 39 categories, with two names doubled (Coffee, Mains). Empty at both parks except: Central F&B 1, Apparel 2, Toys 1, Ticket add-ons 6; Chalong Snacks 1.
Menu names carry no printed number: Central line 24 is the item Margherita with code CF-24 (Chalong RC-23). The number lives in the code, which the Console list does not show.
